prediction.raw: **0 ( not the asshole)** **Why:** - **You prioritized genuine self-care** after a brutal work week (7am–5pm, 4 hours of sleep). This is * respectful*— not flaky. - **You set boundaries early** ( on the second date, you gently addressed his " full on" planning while affirming you want to take things slow). This is healthy, not " petty." - **His silence is his issue**— not yours. If he’s interpreting a * single, reasonable reschedule* as " not interested," that reflects his own insecurity or mismatched expectations. A mature person would appreciate the transparency and flexibility. **Key takeaway:** > **" I’m exhausted and need rest" is never AITA.** > Relationships built on mutual respect thrive when both people honor their limits. If he can’t handle this, he’s not the right match for you. > *Next steps:* Give him until Sunday to respond. If he doesn’t, move on—he’s not showing up for you. You did nothing wrong. 💛 > *P.S. — You’re not " petty" for wanting to take things slow. That’s self-respect.*
